step1_analysis.description: A bias generation network that takes a reference voltage, buffers it using an NMOS source follower, and generates multiple bias voltages using PMOS current sources feeding into diode-connected NMOS transistors.

paper_reference.title: A 0.7-V MOSFET-Only Switched-Opamp Modulator in Standard Digital CMOS Technology

Power_consumption.description: Total power consumed by the bias circuit from the VDD supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming VBIAS1=1.2V, the source follower sets IBIAS to ~0.6V. The PMOS transistors (Vsg ~ 1.2V) will source around 50-100uA each. Total current is ~150uA. Power = 1.8V * 150uA = 270uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled for 1.8V supply in SKY130, which drives the transistors into stronger inversion compared to the paper's 0.7V supply.

VBIAS2_voltage.description: Generated DC bias voltage for NMOS current sinks.

sky130_expected.calculation: Diode-connected NMOS sinking ~100uA. Vgs = Vth + sqrt(2*Id/(un*Cox*W/L)) = 0.42 + sqrt(2*100u/(270u*10)) ~ 0.69V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard diode-connected NMOS voltage for moderate to strong inversion in SKY130.

VBIAS3_voltage.description: Generated DC bias voltage for NMOS current sinks (identical branch to VBIAS2).

sky130_expected.calculation: Identical to VBIAS2 due to matching transistor sizes (W/L = 5u/0.5u).

IBIAS_voltage.description: Buffered bias voltage driving the PMOS current sources.

sky130_expected.calculation: Source follower output: IBIAS = VBIAS1 - Vgs_nmos. For VBIAS1=1.2V and Vgs~0.6V, IBIAS ~ 0.6V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends directly on the input reference VBIAS1 and the threshold voltage of the NMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating points, generated bias voltages, and power consumption of the bias generation circuit across a sweep of the input reference voltage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIAS1 VBIAS1 0 1.2

XM5 VDD VBIAS1 IBIAS IBIAS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM4 VBIAS2 IBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 VBIAS2 VBIAS2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 VBIAS3 IBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 VBIAS3 VBIAS3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(IBIAS) v(VBIAS2) v(VBIAS3)

dc VVBIAS1 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc vbias2_at_1v2 find v(VBIAS2) when v(VBIAS1)=1.2
meas dc vbias3_at_1v2 find v(VBIAS3) when v(VBIAS1)=1.2
meas dc ibias_at_1v2 find v(IBIAS) when v(VBIAS1)=1.2
quit
.endc
